en.title: Math Homework
en.description:
Start from index 0 and move +1 or +2 at each step; stop as soon as the spread of the solved points first reaches threshold; if it can never be reached, solve the entire array as the problem states.

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.input: points is non-decreasing, n≤100000, and the values and threshold are in 1..999.
en.output: Output the minimum number of problems; if the threshold cannot be reached, output n.
en.explanation: Since the points are non-decreasing, the spread grows monotonically with the last index; always stepping +2 reaches the farthest position in the fewest steps.
